_about: Players named in trade reports this winter, read by the trade block, the club pages and trade pick'em. rows: [MLBAM id, rank on MLB Trade Rumors' top trade candidates list (0 = not ranked), reporter credited ('' = none), why in our own words (short, no player name), 1 if a long shot (0 if not), club abbreviation the report is about, date the report was last confirmed on file (YYYY-MM-DD)]. The page drops a report if the player is now with another club or moved after that date. off: ids reported as NOT available, with the note. names is for people reading this file; the page ignores it.
